    • pollutantPpmvDry

      public Map<String,Double> pollutantPpmvDry
      Pollutant concentrations on a DRY basis [ppmv] (water removed). This is the basis on which stack CEMS report and on which emission limits are written, so use these (or pollutantPpmvAtReferenceO2) for a compliance check, not the wet-basis pollutantPpmv.

    • pollutantPpmvAtReferenceO2

      public Map<String,Double> pollutantPpmvAtReferenceO2
      Pollutant concentrations corrected to the reference dry-O2 basis [ppmv] (null if no reference set). Computed from the dry-basis concentration at the dry exhaust O2, which is the physically consistent chain for the standard air-dilution correction.

    • referenceO2VolPercent

      public double referenceO2VolPercent
      Reference dry-O2 basis [vol%] used for pollutantPpmvAtReferenceO2 (NaN if not set).

    • pollutantMgPerNm3Dry

      public Map<String,Double> pollutantMgPerNm3Dry
      Pollutant concentrations on a DRY basis in mg/Nm3 at the normal reference temperature (NOx as NO2). This is the EU IED / EN 14792 (NOx) / EN 15058 (CO) / EN 14791 (SO2) reporting unit; use pollutantMgPerNm3AtReferenceO2 for the limit-comparison value at the reference O2.

    • pollutantMgPerNm3AtReferenceO2

      public Map<String,Double> pollutantMgPerNm3AtReferenceO2
      Pollutant concentrations in mg/Nm3 (dry) corrected to the reference O2 (NOx as NO2), null if no reference O2 set. This is the value directly comparable with a permit / IED emission limit in mg/Nm3.
